sources.quote: 34 Boötis, also named Alrumh, is a single variable star in the northern constellation Boötes, located around 700 light years away from the Sun.

introduction.text: Its brightness, measured band by band, gives 2,193 times the Sun's luminosity at 3,659 K, so 116.702 solar radii.

sources.quote: At that distance, the visual magnitude of the star is diminished by an extinction of 0.49±0.02 due to interstellar dust.
